voltage_levels.voltage_note: Existing 400/130 kV transmission substation. 130 kV rebuilt from single-breaker to double-breaker design.

scope_description: Brownfield expansion of Repbäcken transmission substation (400/130 kV) located in Borlänge, Dalarna. Expansion of existing station area to enable rebuild — large portion can be built outside energized parts. New portals to handle increased short-circuit forces. Rebuild of 130 kV from single-breaker to double-breaker design (9 existing bays, line, and transformer). Connects to the transmission grid via a 420 kV line from Svenska Kraftnät's station at Bäsna. Strategic node in Dalarna's regional grid with seven 130 kV line bays and need for more.

equipment_scope.note: Rebuild of existing single-breaker 130 kV bays to double-breaker; 9 existing bays plus line and transformer bays.

timeline.timeline_note: Procurement 2026-03-20 to 2026-09-24. Construction 2027-04 to 2030-04 per slide 19. Commission marker on Gantt at 2030.

contract.contract_note: Estimated contract value >200 MSEK per slide 19. Standalone supplementary procurement.

narrative_note: Repbäcken is the most concretely scheduled supplementary project in this deck — explicit procurement and construction dates published. Connects to Svenska Kraftnät via 420 kV line to Svk station at Bäsna.
